scenarios.title: Big tech peer comparison
scenarios.description: Large-cap technology peers with deep, comparable fundamentals. Strong for peer-relative z-scores and cross-sectional outliers.
scenarios.goal: Find unusual financial changes for this technology peer set and surface peer-relative and self-relative signals.
look_for: unified_findings.csv — rows with finding_type peer_relative: who diverges from the group on revenue, margins, or growth metrics.
anomalies.csv — self_relative spikes or dips versus each company’s own history.
peer_signals.csv — peer means/spreads that drive peer-relative flags.
trend_break_signals.csv — sustained shifts (trend_signal_type / trend_score) that may overlap anomalies on the same (cik, period, metric).
report.md — narrative summary tying anomalies, peers, and data-quality caveats together.

scenarios.title: Mixed sector panel
scenarios.description: Diverse industries on one panel. Highlights how the stack handles heterogeneous businesses and both cross-sectional and time-series views.
scenarios.goal: Run anomaly analysis across companies in different sectors and call out unusual changes and peer context where peers exist.
look_for: Peer-relative findings may be sparse or noisy across sectors — compare with self_relative rows.
data_quality_summary.csv — missingness and coverage differ by sector/metric; trustworthiness fields explain limitations.
metric_coverage_summary.csv — which metrics are populated across this mixed set.
unified_findings.csv — mix of deterioration, data_limitations, and peer_outlier categories when applicable.

scenarios.title: Retail / consumer peer set
scenarios.description: Tight consumer/retail peer group where cross-sectional comparison is meaningful — good for clear peer-relative anomaly stories.
scenarios.goal: Compare this retail peer set and flag unusual financial changes with emphasis on peer-relative outliers.
look_for: peer_relative rows in unified_findings.csv — retailers diverging from peers on growth, margin, or efficiency metrics.
peer_signals.csv — peer aggregates for the same period/metric keys as anomalies.
Overlap metadata (overlap_count, overlap_sources) when a name shows both anomaly and trend-break style signals.
report.md — readable ranking of the most material moves.

scenarios.title: Semiconductor peer set
scenarios.description: Semiconductor peers with cyclical, comparable drivers — strong demo for peer bands and cycle-sensitive anomalies.
scenarios.goal: Find unusual financial changes in this semiconductor peer group and highlight peer-relative and trend-based signals.
look_for: unified_findings.csv — peer_relative findings tied to cycle metrics (growth, gross margin, capex intensity).
trend_break_signals.csv — breakouts or breakdowns that may coincide with peer stress.
anomalies.csv — company-specific extremes versus historical baselines.
Combined view: same (cik, period, metric) appearing in both anomaly and trend layers when overlap is computed.
